summary: Reviewed recent commits (meilisearch startup indexing, container init path fixes). Found 6 issues: entrypoint.sh doesn't exec "$@" so init service never runs migration/sync, lifespan swallows Meilisearch index-create errors, facets cache masks the resulting empty state for up to an hour, sys.path fallback duplicated across 3 scripts, migrate_to_pg silently creates empty sqlite on missing source file, unused redis/jinja2 deps at project root.
author: devhax

summary: Fixed all 6 code review findings after Chesterton's-Fence analysis of prior commits: entrypoint.sh now execs $@ so the docker init service actually runs migration/sync; narrowed bare except to MeilisearchApiError in lifespan/search/facets, and search/facets now raise HTTPException(503) instead of caching an empty index_not_found fallback for up to an hour; deduped sys.path bootstrap into scripts/_pathutil.py; migrate_to_pg.find_data_file now raises FileNotFoundError instead of silently creating an empty sqlite db; dropped unused jinja2 from root pyproject.toml (kept redis, which is transitively required). Verified: py_compile, sh -n, direct + package-style import of all three scripts, and app.main imports cleanly in backend env.
author: devhax

summary: Ran docker compose up (db/redis/meilisearch/init only, isolated from the live swarm stack on this host) to verify the entrypoint.sh exec-$@ fix. Confirmed the init container now actually runs scripts/init_all.py end-to-end (migration + sync) instead of silently starting uvicorn. Migration succeeded on first run. Sync then hit a previously-hidden, unrelated bug: yield_per()+joinedload() on a collection (Course.slots) raised SQLAlchemy InvalidRequestError -- meaning meilisearch sync had never actually completed in any deployment. Fixed by switching to selectinload(Course.slots).joinedload(CourseSlot.room). Re-ran: exit 0, 136939 docs indexed in Meilisearch, confirmed via /indexes/courses/stats. Tore down with docker compose down -v; swarm stack (boununi-bountools-koytha, boununi-scraper-pw6pfa) confirmed untouched.
author: devhax
